raw_segments.text: If you have the heart to be so, you mean bitty," said I, in a virtuous and superior tone.
I am very sorry to see it, and it's a bad side of human nature.
I didn't tend to ask you to use any little opportunities you might have after I was gone
But after this, I ask you nothing.
I am extremely sorry to see this in you, bitty,' I repeated.
It's a bad side of human nature."
